io.import_desc: Select a JSON backup file to load. This will replace the current list or Nemesis state depending on the file type.
nemesis.no_mods_detected: No animation mods detected for this engine.
modal.name: Name
csv.missing_desc: For the plugin to work, you need to export your mod list from MO2:
csv.missing_step1: In MO2, go to Open List Options > Export CSV
csv.missing_step3: Save the file as modlist.csv in the MO2 root folder
modlist.confirm_delete: Remove this mod from memory? This action cannot be undone.
modlist.confirm_refresh_csv: Refresh from CSV? This will reload ALL data from the CSV: priority, category, version, MO2 comment and link. The current stored modlist information will be replaced. Only comment 2 (editable by you) will be kept.
backups.title: Backups
backups.desc: Create and restore full backups of your mod list (includes Nemesis state). Backups are saved as JSON.
backups.none: No backups. Create one with the button above.
backups.confirm_restore: Restore this backup? This will replace your current list and Nemesis state.
io.title: Import / Export backups
io.desc: Import or export backups in JSON format to share or load lists from other folders or profiles. You can export your mod list or Nemesis/Pandora/Custom state, and import external backups.
app.title: Modlist Manager
backups.restore_list:
Restore mod list (database)?

This will replace: priority, name, category, version, MO2 comment, link and active state.
backups.restore_comments:
Also restore personal comment and edits (overrides)?

This will replace: personal comment, edited category, edited link and tags.
backups.what_modlist: Mod list: priority, name, category, version, MO2 comment, link
backups.what_memory: Overrides: personal comment, edited category, edited link, tags
io.what_modlist: Mod list: priority, name, category, version, MO2 comment, link
io.what_memory: Overrides: personal comment, edited category, edited link, tags
io.what_nemesis: Nemesis/Pandora/Custom: enabled, disabled, manual mods (list only, no images)
reconnect.title: Server disconnected
reconnect.desc: The server shut down due to inactivity. Reopen the plugin from MO2 (double-click Modlist Manager) or press the button to retry.
modlist.sync_mo2_title: Reads meta.ini of all mods as MO2 does when exporting CSV
modlist.refresh_csv_title: Updates from the CSV exported by MO2
plugins.title: Plugin Slots
plugins.desc: Shows which mods use plugin slots (.esp/.esm/.esl) in your load order. The game limit is 255 active plugins. .esp files flagged as ESL (ESPFE) are detected by reading the binary header and counted as Light, not as standard ESP.
plugins.none: No data. Click Scan to load.
modlist.hide_deleted_title: Hide deleted mods from the main list
deleted.title: Deleted mods
deleted.desc: These mods were on your list but their folder no longer exists on disk. Use this view to isolate them from the main list and decide whether to forget them (remove from the database) or reinstall them.
deleted.forget_all_title: Remove all filtered mods from the database
deleted.none_filtered: No mods match the current filters.
deleted.confirm_forget_one: Are you sure you want to forget this mod? It will be permanently removed from the database. This action cannot be undone.
deleted.none_to_forget: No mods to forget with the current filters
deleted.confirm_forget_all: Are you sure you want to forget {count} mods? They will be permanently removed from the database. This action cannot be undone.
versions.title: Mod versions
versions.desc: Lists installed mods with their Nexus ID, current version and direct link to the installed version. The version link allows downloading specific files even if the author has archived them, using the file_id from meta.ini.
versions.none: No mods. Click Refresh to load.
versions.none_filtered: No mods match the current filters.
versions.custom_desc: Manually add links to specific mod versions. Enter the mod ID, file ID and name. The link is generated automatically. Data is saved to the profile and can be backed up.
versions.error_fields_required: Name, Mod ID and File ID are required
versions.confirm_delete_entry: Are you sure you want to delete this entry?
versions.backups_desc: Create and restore backups of the mods list (with version links) and the custom list. Backups are saved as JSON.
versions.no_backups: No backups. Create one with the buttons above.
versions.restore_custom_only: Only custom list backups can be restored
versions.confirm_restore: Restore this backup? The current custom list will be replaced by the backup.
versions.confirm_delete_backup: Are you sure you want to delete this backup?
versions.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the popup. Allow popups for this site.
versions.copy_to_custom_title: Save this version to the custom list
versions.copy_no_fileid: Copied without File ID (fill it manually in the custom list)
versions.updated_desc: Compare the current database against a previous backup and list mods whose version has changed. Use the dropdown to pick the reference backup (manual or auto-backup taken at MO2 startup).
datasource.title: How do you want to load your mod list?
datasource.desc: You can change this later in the plugin settings.
datasource.modlist_desc: Reads modlist.txt + meta.ini directly. No CSV export needed. Best for lists under 2000 mods.
datasource.csv_desc: Requires exporting a CSV from MO2 first. Much faster for 3000+ mods. Priority, comments, and categories come from the CSV.
modlist.confirm_sync_mo2: This will update the list by reading modlist.txt + meta.ini of each mod. This may take several minutes depending on the number of mods. Continue?
csv.not_found_warning: No CSV file detected. Please generate one following the steps.
topbar.profile_select_title: Select a profile to switch to
settings.title: Settings
settings.ds_csv: CSV exported from MO2 (fast for large lists)
settings.data_source_desc: Changing this mode deletes database.json and reloads all data from scratch with the new mode. Your personal comments (comment2) and tags are preserved.
settings.ui_language_desc: Changes apply immediately. The tooltip texts in MO2's own settings dialog will update on next MO2 restart.
Automatically open the browser when the: Automatically open the browser when the plugin starts
Start the web server when MO2 starts (if: Start the web server when MO2 starts (if false, server starts on-demand when you open the plugin)
Data source: 'csv' = use MO2 exported CS: Data source: 'csv' = use MO2 exported CSV (faster for large modlists, requires manual CSV export) | 'modlist' = read modlist.txt + meta.ini directly (no CSV needed, slower for 3000+ mods) | '' = ask on first launch
Enable debug logging to modlist_manager_: Enable debug logging to modlist_manager_debug.txt (cleared on each MO2 restart)
Web UI language override ('auto' = follo: Web UI language override ('auto' = follow MO2's interface language, or 'en'/'es'/'ru'/... to force a specific language). Can also be changed at runtime from the web plugin's settings gear.
